title: Weekly English Review
summary: This week's news highlights significant developments across various sectors, including economic pressures on American companies due to tariffs and rising costs, as well as advancements in space exploration with SpaceX's new funding from NASA. Additionally, the Taiwanese Taiex index reached a record high, driven by optimism in the technology sector, while Meta's introduction of a consumer AI product has sparked concerns in the financial markets. Furthermore, the Federal Reserve's anticipated interest rate hike and the restoration of press access to major news outlets underscore ongoing tensions in the political landscape.
shadowing: American companies are facing significant challenges due to tariffs and rising costs.
SpaceX has secured funding for additional crewed flights to the ISS.
The Taiex index in Taiwan reached a record intraday high driven by tech gains.
Meta's new AI product has triggered upheaval in the financial markets.
The market anticipates a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in October.
